summary: Per-field provenance is incorrectly assigned to fields with no value, misrepresenting source data.
claim: UI displays a source for missing data; edited records may claim catalog provenance for fields never present, violating per-field provenance preservation.

evidence.source: CatalogEntry.asCatalogItem() sets all EDITABLE_FIELDS to OFD source regardless of field presence; CustomRecord.asItem() inherits source strings even when value is blank/zero.

suggested_remediation: Assign source only when a value exists; for missing/null/blank fields use empty source or explicit 'Missing' marker, and preserve this in snapshots.
suggested_validation: Test that a catalog entry with null nozzleMin gets nozzleMin source empty (or 'Missing'), not 'OFD revision'; saving edited record preserves empty source.
